description: tsproject/v1 — A composer reconciled by the TypeScript demo worker. compose() fans a list of teams into one account per team plus a project bucket, wired by a value-flow edge (bucket.account_id ← the first account's status). rollup() aggregates the settled children into the root's Ready condition. Proof the TS SDK does the full compose→children→value-flow→rollup flow a Go composer does, over the same broker + worker.proto.

project.description: Project name; the prefix for composed child names. Defaults to the resource name if omitted.

teams.description: Owner teams; one account child is composed per team.
